---
title: "Week 07 Interactive Demo"
format: html
---

Source note: learner-facing demo is authored directly in `interactive_demo.html` to support bilingual UI, no-JS fallback, dynamic SVG, and GitHub Pages-safe interaction without a build step.

The demo lets learners:

- choose an activity focus;
- adjust four rubric scores;
- inspect a dynamic rubric bar chart;
- read a generated Methods sentence;
- keep claims descriptive rather than causal.
